name: @cinatra-ai/execution-plane
description: Execution-plane broker + sandbox worker (exec-plane S1, cinatra#1706): opens the sealed execution-session carrier minted by @cinatra-ai/llm, revalidates run liveness per command, enforces per-org quotas and bounded queueing, and dispatches each command to a fresh hardened container over the digest-pinned L0 image with a per-run L2 workspace volume (enforced disk quota) and network-layer egress policy (none / allowlist / default-internet, all via the attributing egress gateway). Local-dev worker placement; other placements ride the deployment layer.
